chosenApproach: Create only an isolated documentation/test release marker PR based on verified main, merge with existing strictly gated production marker prefix; both production workflows compile and verify the same resulting main SHA. No direct Github push or ad hoc Expo EAS call.
selectionRationale: Prior releases use this gated prefix, branch protection and exact immutable RC; source code itself has completed cumulative compilation and changing release workflows or building another source would create unnecessary risk.
alternativeApproaches: Publish from intermediate integration branch: rejected because it is not protected main or final release fingerprint.
Copy old RC exports or publish individually from feature branches: rejected because the served source would diverge and ABI/publication gates would be bypassed.
Reuse original protected-main release mechanism with marker-only PR: chosen.
